about: Quotations checked with quote_check against the live Project Gutenberg text. 'expect' is the right answer: found or not, and for found quotes the strictest match level. Real quotes were confirmed by searching the downloaded text by hand; misquotes are well-known misquotations or film lines. Labels written by hand.

cases.quote: Call me Ishmael.
From hell's heart I stab at thee
cases.why: mid-sentence in the book: 'thee; from hell’s heart'. (Labeled 'typography' in the first run; the label was wrong.)

cases.quote: It is a truth universally acknowledged that a single man in possession of a good fortune must be in want of a wife.
cases.why: the book has a comma after 'acknowledged'
